test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Which of the following words means "prohibited by law or treaty from being imported or exported"?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Contraband**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Contraband"** refers to goods that are prohibited by law or treaty from being imported or exported. (कानून या संधि द्वारा प्रतिबंधित वस्तु)
 
 
• **Example:** The police seized contraband items at the border that were being smuggled illegally.
 

 
• **Explanation:** The word "Contraband" specifically relates to illegal goods that are smuggled or traded against regulations. (निषिद्ध वस्तु)
 
 
• **Example:** The customs officers are trained to identify and confiscate contraband goods.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Contraband**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Restricted** (प्रतिबंधित): Limited in scope or extent; controlled or regulated.
 
 
• **Example:** Access to the restricted area is only granted to authorized personnel.
 
 

 
• **Illegal** (अवैध): Something that is forbidden by law or statute.
 
 
• **Example:** It is illegal to drive a vehicle without a valid license.
 
 

 
• **Banned** (प्रतिबंधित): Officially prohibited; forbidden by authority.
 
 
• **Example:** Smoking in public places has been banned in many cities.
 
 

58:T91c,
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
